h1: Klean Residence Hotel Bangkok — a 3-star Thonburi base 150 m from BTS Wongwian Yai with free parking and genuinely clean rooms
intro: If you want a Thonburi base where you can walk to the BTS in two minutes without overpaying, Klean Residence Hotel in Soi Krung Thonburi 4, Khlong San, does exactly that. BTS Wongwian Yai (Silom Green Line) is just 150 metres away — two stops gets you to Saphan Taksin for the river ferry to ICONSIAM; one more to Silom and Sathorn. A 24-hour 7-Eleven sits right across the street. Nine floors, 68 rooms, free parking, free Wi-Fi — Trip.com 8.6 from 474 real guest reviews, praised for cleanliness, location and friendly staff. From approx. ฿870/night.

body.html: Who Klean Residence is for — this hotel has a clear purpose: a clean, affordable base on the Thonburi side of Bangkok with direct BTS walkability. People who get the most from it are: office workers commuting to Silom or Sathorn who want to sleep on the quieter Thonburi bank; travellers who want to explore Talat Phlu's legendary street-food market, Wat Inthanaram, the King Taksin Monument at Wongwian Yai, or make easy day trips to ICONSIAM and the Chao Phraya; and drivers who want to park for free and hop on the BTS to avoid Bangkok's traffic. For those expecting a rooftop infinity pool or sleek design-hotel aesthetic, this is not the right fit. But for anyone who values walkability to the BTS, real cleanliness, and value pricing, Klean Residence consistently delivers.

Location and getting around — the hotel stands at 69 Soi Krung Thonburi 4, Krungthonburi Road, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600 — the inner Thonburi district on the west bank of the Chao Phraya. BTS Wongwian Yai (Silom/Green Line) is approximately 150 metres away, a comfortable 2-minute walk. Ride 1 stop north to BTS Krung Thon Buri, which connects with the BTS Sukhumvit Line. Ride 2 stops to BTS Saphan Taksin and take the free shuttle ferry across to ICONSIAM. The neighbourhood itself is rich with local character: Talat Phlu street-food market is about 1.5 km away, Wat Inthanaram is roughly a 13-minute walk, and the King Taksin roundabout is a 7-minute stroll. Suvarnabhumi Airport is around a 35–45-minute drive, depending on traffic.
"Very clean room, super friendly staff. Walked to the BTS in two minutes. 7-Eleven right outside. Outstanding value for the price in Bangkok."

Rooms and facilities — the hotel has 68 rooms across 9 floors in four tiers: Express, Superior, Deluxe and Grand Deluxe. All rooms are air-conditioned and come with flat-screen TV, safe, refrigerator and free Wi-Fi; some Deluxe and Grand Deluxe rooms have private balconies. Superior rooms measure around 18 sq m — compact but well-organised. Décor is plain and functional: nothing Instagram-worthy, but spotlessly maintained. Housekeeping comes daily. The on-site restaurant and café serve continental breakfast from 07:00–10:00 (charged separately); the hotel does not include breakfast in the standard room rate. Self-service laundry is available at ฿30 per machine load. Free parking is on site but limited in number — an essential detail for drivers. Trip.com scores location 8.9, cleanliness 8.8 and service 8.7 — all above the platform average for Bangkok 3-star properties.

Service and staff — across platforms, the most consistent theme in real guest reviews is the friendly, helpful attitude of the front-desk team. Booking.com gives staff the highest sub-score at 8.6. The 24-hour reception means late check-ins and early departures are handled without fuss. Luggage storage is available. Early check-in and late check-out are possible at an extra charge — confirm when booking if your flight or bus schedule needs flexibility. The property also has 24-hour security.

What guests actually say — honest pros and cons — based on 474 Trip.com reviews (8.6/10) and 41 Booking.com reviews (7.8/10). What guests consistently praise: the BTS walkability is the number-one cited reason for choosing this hotel; rooms are clean and housekeeping is attentive; staff go out of their way to help; the 7-Eleven across the street and nearby restaurants make daily life easy; and the free parking removes real stress for road-trip travellers. What guests flag: air-conditioning units can be noisy — this is the single most-cited complaint across platforms, particularly for lower floors and street-facing rooms. Wi-Fi scored only 6.9 on Booking.com, with some rooms getting weaker signals. Parking is limited and can fill up during public holidays. A handful of older reviews mention cleanliness issues such as pests, but recent reviews following building renovations do not repeat this — the consensus since 2023 is clean.

Price and value — Superior rooms start from around ฿870/night in mid-season, with Express rooms slightly cheaper. Deluxe and Grand Deluxe rooms with balconies run roughly ฿1,100–1,500. Booking.com's value-for-money sub-score is 8.3 — higher than the overall score, which tells you guests leave feeling they got more than they paid for. Compare that to equivalent 3-star properties near BTS stations on Silom or Sukhumvit, where the floor price is typically ฿1,500–2,000, and the positioning is clear: you're getting a BTS-walkable room on the less-touristy Thonburi side at a meaningful discount.

Bottom line — Klean Residence Hotel earns its strong rating through a combination of a genuinely excellent BTS location, consistent cleanliness, and staff who take pride in the property. It does not pretend to be a boutique hotel: rooms are compact and practical, and the AC can disturb light sleepers. But if your priorities are walking to the BTS in two minutes, free parking, clean rooms, and honest value on the Thonburi side of Bangkok, this hotel ticks every box. Trip.com's 8.6 from nearly 500 real guests is a reliable signal — this is a property that delivers what it promises.

honestSummary: Klean Residence Hotel is a strong choice if you need a clean, walkable-BTS Thonburi base with free parking at a budget price — 150 m from BTS Wongwian Yai, Trip.com 8.6 from 474 real guests, from approx. ฿870/night. Two things to know going in: the AC can be noisy (ask for a higher floor), and parking is free but limited.
honestChecks: If you are a light sleeper — real reviewers repeatedly mention noisy AC units, particularly on lower floors and street-facing rooms → request a higher floor or a courtyard-facing room at check-in, and pack earplugs as a precaution.

If you are arriving by car and need guaranteed parking — free parking is confirmed but limited in number. On long weekends and peak season (October–February) it can fill early → call the hotel the day before to confirm a space is available.

If you need breakfast included in your room rate — Klean Residence charges separately for its continental breakfast (07:00–10:00). If an included breakfast matters to your budget, compare rate plans at booking or grab something from the 7-Eleven across the street for far less.

tips.title: Take BTS toward National Stadium for Silom / Sathorn
tips.body: From BTS Wongwian Yai, ride towards National Stadium: 1 stop to Krung Thon Buri (connects to BTS Sukhumvit Line), 2 stops to Saphan Taksin for the free shuttle ferry to ICONSIAM. Far cheaper and faster than a Grab across the river during peak hours.

tips.title: Confirm your parking spot the day before
tips.body: Free parking is real but limited. If you're driving to the hotel on a public holiday or long weekend, call ahead the day before to confirm a space is reserved — don't assume on arrival.

tips.title: Request a higher floor to reduce AC noise
tips.body: The most-cited complaint in real reviews is noisy air-conditioning units, mostly on lower floors. When checking in, ask for floor 5 or above and a room that faces away from the main road. Pack earplugs if you are a sensitive sleeper.

tips.title: Don't miss Talat Phlu for dinner
tips.body: Talat Phlu street-food market — one of Bangkok's most-loved neighbourhood food scenes — is only 1.5 km from the hotel. Grab a motorcycle taxi for a few baht, or walk along Krungthonburi Road. Best visited from around 4 p.m. to 8 p.m.

faq.q: Where is Klean Residence Hotel Bangkok and how far is it from BTS Wongwian Yai?
faq.a: The hotel is at 69 Soi Krung Thonburi 4, Krungthonburi Road, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600. It is approximately 150 metres from BTS Wongwian Yai (Silom/Green Line) — about a 2-minute walk. This makes it one of the closest budget-priced hotels to a BTS station on the Thonburi side of Bangkok.

faq.q: Does Klean Residence Hotel Bangkok have free parking?
faq.a: Yes — free self parking is available in the hotel grounds. The number of spaces is limited, so if you plan to arrive by car — especially on a long weekend or during peak season (October–February) — call the hotel a day in advance to confirm a space is available. The key advantage: park free and walk 2 minutes to the BTS to reach the rest of Bangkok without fighting traffic.

faq.q: How do I get from Klean Residence Hotel to ICONSIAM?
faq.a: It is very straightforward: walk 2 minutes to BTS Wongwian Yai → ride 2 stops to BTS Saphan Taksin → take the free shuttle ferry directly to ICONSIAM. Total journey is around 15 minutes, and you pay only a BTS fare — far quicker and cheaper than a taxi during peak hours.

faq.q: Is breakfast included at Klean Residence Hotel Bangkok?
faq.a: Continental breakfast is available (07:00–10:00) but is not included in the standard room rate — it is charged separately. A 24-hour 7-Eleven sits directly across the street for quick, affordable morning options if you'd rather not pay the hotel's breakfast rate.

faq.q: What is the room rate at Klean Residence Hotel Bangkok?
faq.a: Standard Superior rooms start from approx. ฿870/night in mid-season. Express rooms can be slightly cheaper; Deluxe and Grand Deluxe rooms with balconies run around ฿1,100–1,500. During Thai public holidays and the high-travel window (October–February) rates rise. Book in advance and choose a free-cancellation rate for flexibility.
